verdict.rationale: Formant is a robotics fleet platform, so sensor integration is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence only shows agent installation on ROS1/ROS2 devices, configurable data streams, and SDK telemetry ingestion. Nothing documents ready-made drivers for cameras, lidars, IMUs, or GPS, or Formant-provided standard sensor message types. Any ROS message types come from the host platform, not from Formant.
